tonight.headline: Three coin flips still unset — Tuten's locks Thursday
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten, still in the FLEX, missed Monday's and Tuesday's practices (DK 3 Nov; Yahoo 4 Nov) and locks into that slot at Thursday's 19:15 CDMX kickoff. Jonathan Taylor is in 'active and ongoing' trade talks before the NFL's 10 Nov deadline (Bleacher Report 31 Oct). Josh Jacobs faces new allegations with no league action (FFB ~31 Oct-2 Nov).

As set Bloodsports project 130.6 against Jackrabbits' 123.6; the projection lineup is 133.5. Overnight the owner dropped Pitts and added Woody Marks as a free agent — no priority spent. Make the three swaps, Gordon for Tuten first.

case.label: Their lineup
case.body: Jackrabbits start Henry and Zay Flowers at Baltimore Thursday, behind third-string rookie Joe Fagnano (CBS 3 Nov) — against your Jaguars D/ST. Burrow plays in Madrid.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Bloodsports set the projection lineup and still lose by more than 10 — then it was the roster, not the lineup.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 5 Nov 19:15 CDMX (Tuten locks at kickoff)
doFirst.title: Start Gordon in the FLEX, bench Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: 16.5 to 15.4 — a coin flip the projection takes, and two missed practices point the same way.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Gordon 16.5, Tuten 15.4: inside two points. Take the projection; no thesis.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Tuten DNP Monday and Tuesday (DK 3 Nov; Yahoo 4 Nov 01:55Z). Gordon is Miami's lead back, 19 and 25 carries the last two weeks (archive). Once Jacksonville kick off Thursday, Tuten is locked in.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten outscores Gordon in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Rice, bench Garrett Wilson
doFirst.subtitle: 13.9 to 12.8 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Rice 13.9, Wilson 12.8: inside two points.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Rice back from the hamstring, 7-53-1 on 8 targets in Week 8 (FFB ~2 Nov); Wilson 12 targets but at Kansas City. Neither is a reason; the number is.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson outscores Rice in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Likely at TE, bench Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: 12.8 to 12.1 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Likely 12.8, Loveland 12.1: inside one point.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Loveland drew 9 targets Monday with Kmet out for the season (FantasyData 3 Nov); Likely goes to Philadelphia, 2nd-toughest on TEs, with McCarthy's second start (Inquirer 4 Nov). Matchups are not overrides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland outscores Likely in Week 9 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Three coin flips are still set the wrong way
whatWentWrong.lead: 2.9 projected points unset, one on a player who has missed two practices and locks Thursday.

case.body: The only move since Tuesday was the 08:14Z Pitts-for-Marks swap (activity log); the lineup is unchanged.

roster.footnote: No Week 9 game has started. Rows show the lineup as set at 12:50Z; verdicts show the projection lineup. Grades are rank in fantasy points allowed to the position, StatChasers weeks 1-8 updated 3 Nov (half-PPR, 1 = toughest); D/ST and K not graded.

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 2.9 below the projection lineup across three coin flips — Gordon over Tuten, Rice over Wilson, Likely over Loveland; take the projection on all three.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: A free agent here — no priority — but the split was Kubiak's design, not an injury.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83 and 0 targets in his first start; Jeanty 2 carries and 64 receiving. Kubiak: Jeanty's light load was 'by design' and he is 'still going to be a big part' (Rotowire 1 Nov).

case.label: Why not
case.body: Bloodsports now carry five backs including Marks, added this morning; a sixth would need a drop that is a starter elsewhere in the week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco — then a free-agent add for Marks if Montgomery is back in Houston.

doNotChase.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
doNotChase.lead: Dropped this morning — don't claim him back.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 2 catches for 6 on 5 targets in Week 8 with Penix 8-of-24, 4 INT (FFB ~2 Nov); a third tight end behind Likely and Loveland. Reclaiming him costs IPADE priority for the season and reverses today's move.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely or Loveland hurt for weeks.

case.label: What would change it
